label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness) is TP: java.util.Random is used to generate rememberMeKey (line 68-97) which is stored in session attributes and cookies - a known security weakness requiring SecureRandom. Alert 2 (java/xss) is FP: tracing the sink expression at lines 106-111 reveals the resolved sink values are "Inga" + testCaseNumber (server-side constructed from class name, not user input) for the if branch, and rememberMe properties (cookieName=server-derived, rememberMeKey=random-generated) for the else branch - neither contains attacker-controlled data.

evidence.note: Alert 1: java.util.Random.nextInt() generates rememberMeKey used for session tokens - insecure randomness
Alert 2: User cookie value flows into param/bar but bar is never used in sink expression
